map.角焊缝/对接焊缝/点焊强度与许用载荷计算: Strength and allowable-load calculation for fillet welds, butt welds and spot welds
map.💡 角焊缝喉厚 a=0.707K，有效面积 A=a·L；对接焊缝按板厚计算。许用: 💡 Fillet weld throat a=0.707K, effective area A=a·L; butt welds are computed by plate thickness. Allowable shear stress [τ]≈0.4σb (AWS D1.1).
map.角焊缝 τ=F/(0.707·K·L)、对接 σ=F/(t·L) 校核。: Fillet weld τ=F/(0.707·K·L), butt weld σ=F/(t·L) verification.
map.点焊推荐焊点直径 d=5√t、点距≈4d。: For spot welding the recommended spot diameter d=5√t and spot spacing ≈4d.
map.校核焊脚 K 是否在 0.7t–1.2t 合理范围。: Check whether the weld leg K is within the reasonable range 0.7t-1.2t.
Load F=10 kN, weld leg K=6 mm, weld length L=100 mm: τ=F/(0.707·K·L)=10000/(0.707×6×100)=10000/424.2≈23.6 MPa. Allowable [τ]=120 MPa, satisfied.
map.板厚 t=2 mm：推荐焊点直径 d=5√t=5×1.414≈7.07 mm；点: Plate thickness t=2 mm: recommended spot diameter d=5√t=5×1.414≈7.07 mm; spot spacing ≈4d≈28 mm.
map.角焊缝有效喉厚 a=K·sin45°=0.707K，故剪应力按 0.707K·L: The fillet weld effective throat a=K·sin45°=0.707K, so the shear stress is computed on the throat
map.焊脚 K 太小/太大？: Weld leg K too small / too large?
map.K<0.7t 承载不足、K>1.2t 易烧穿，常规取 K≈0.7t–1.0t（薄: K<0.7t gives insufficient load capacity and K>1.2t tends to burn through; conventionally take K≈0.7t-1.0t (upper limit for thin plates).
